decisions.rationale: Intended Mega Swampert. Lead Gyarados+Arch: Intimidate Incin, Arch walls Rotom LeafStorm (0.25x) and pressures; avoid 4x Tbolt rain lead. Back Pelipper+Swampert complete rain Swift Swim + Electro Shot endgame vs their balance/Kingambit.

Sets: Pelipper Damp Rock Drizzle (Hurricane/Weather Ball/Helping Hand/Protect); Swampertite Mega Swift Swim (EQ/Liquidation/Ice Punch/Protect); Grimmsnarl Light Clay Prankster (screens/Fake Out/Spirit Break, no Protect); Gholdengo Leftovers Good as Gold (Make It Rain/Shadow Ball/Recover/Nasty Plot, immune to Parting Shot); Archaludon Life Orb Stamina — never chip with physical, answer is Gengar Focus Blast (72-139%, Gengar outspeeds); Gyarados Lum Intimidate — Rotom Tbolt 4x-KOs, Defiant Kingambit punishes switch-in. Verified calcs: Rotom Tbolt OHKOs Pelipper (207-409%), Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert (174-311%); Kowtow vs Gholdengo 84.5-150.6%; Iron Head vs Grimmsnarl 72.8-138.8%. decisions.rationale: Aura Sphere guarantees Kingambit OHKO; Gya outspeeds and Ice Fangs Rotom for chip before any Tbolt. Accept Gya trade—Arch lives Kowtow range and cleans. Switch-in Swampert risks King Sucker/Kowtow free damage and loses Gya momentum; no rain so no Electro Shot.

reflections.notebook: Series 1-1. Opp tendencies: aggressive, splits targets; G2 brought Pelipper/Swampert/Archaludon/Gyarados (Grimmsnarl/Gholdengo not brought) and led Gyarados+Archaludon with rain as the backline closer — rain mode is not always their lead. Gyarados DDs then EQs freely even beside its own Archaludon (chips it, feeds Stamina); +1 Jolly Gyarados outruns Mega Gengar (200) and Rotom. Archaludon (LO Stamina, special) near-immune to my roster: Kowtow/Iron Head resisted + Stamina, Rotom Tbolt 0.5x / Leaf Storm 0.25x; at +2 Def even Black Glasses Sucker ~14-24%; confirmed it finishes itself via LO recoil once chipped (died at 6% after Aura Sphere) — chip only when safe; Aura Sphere is a guaranteed OHKO on Kingambit (confirmed) — never eat it. Verified OHKOs: Rotom Tbolt → Pelipper/Gyarados; Leaf Storm → Swampert; Black Glasses Kowtow → Gholdengo (no Protect); Iron Head vs Grimmsnarl 72.8-138.8%; Grimmsnarl Fake Outs on entry. Gyarados (Lum Intimidate, no Protect): 0-Atk Ice Fang vs Rotom ~36-66%. Pelipper speed 85-117 straddles Rotom's 108 (coin flip). Mega Swampert Swift Swim outruns everything and Ice Punch KOs Rotom — answer is Kingambit Sucker Punch or Protect-stalling rain, not Rotom head-on. Rotom's Levitate never revealed through G2 (EQ into it was Protect-blocked) — still a live trap that makes their Gyarados chip their own Archaludon. Kingambit Protect counter resets after any non-Protect turn. G3 plan: lead Rotom+Kingambit vs Gyarados/Archaludon, deprioritize Mega Gengar into this core, preserve Kingambit for Swampert, let Archaludon die to chip + recoil.
